verdict.rationale: Check is an embedded payroll API. Partners create companies, employees, contractors and payrolls through the API and Postman collection. Check handles taxes, money movement and filings so partners can focus on their own product. Over 30 embeddable React Components, which can later be swapped for custom UI, let partners onboard workers and run payroll inside their app, with sandbox testing and webhooks available. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of white-label branding/theming controls for Components, independent hands-on corroboration of a partner embedding experience.
